verdict: BARYON_SPECTRUM_REPRODUCED (scale-free structure): the QNG-Skyrme octet+decuplet reproduces the light-baryon spectrum via Gell-Mann-Okubo (octet) and equal-spacing (decuplet). So QNG identifies all 18 light baryons with masses to ~1% GIVEN 2 scale inputs -- the spectrum STRUCTURE is reproduced; the absolute scale + breaking are the inputs (alpha_s + strange mass).
